# AI Blocks

> Free AI skills, workflows, prompts and minds for real work. Each skill is a reusable SKILL.md for an AI assistant that can read files.

## Connect your AI

- MCP server (public, no sign-in): https://useaiblocks.com/mcp
- Server card: [https://useaiblocks.com/mcp/server-card](https://useaiblocks.com/mcp/server-card), listed in [/.well-known/ai-catalog.json](https://useaiblocks.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)
- REST API: [OpenAPI description](https://useaiblocks.com/api/v1/openapi.json). Search with https://useaiblocks.com/api/v1/search?q=ad+angles, read one item with https://useaiblocks.com/api/v1/items/ad-angle-planner
- Setup guide for ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code and Codex: [Connect your AI](https://useaiblocks.com/api-and-mcp)
- Every item page has a Markdown version and a JSON version: [/skills/ad-angle-planner.md](https://useaiblocks.com/skills/ad-angle-planner.md) and [.json](https://useaiblocks.com/skills/ad-angle-planner.json), linked from each page's head.
- New and changed items: [JSON Feed](https://useaiblocks.com/feed.json) and [RSS](https://useaiblocks.com/feed.xml), plus lastmod dates in the [sitemap](https://useaiblocks.com/sitemap.xml)

Once connected, ask in plain words:

- "Use AI Blocks to get ad-angle-planner."
- "Use AI Blocks to find a skill that writes ad angles."
- "Use AI Blocks to plan a workflow for my weekly report."
- "Use AI Blocks to show what's new this week."

## Key facts

- Browsing, catalogue downloads and manual workflow assembly are free, with no account needed. AI workflow planning requires sign-in and follows the current service limits.
- 5021 skills, workflows and prompts in 70 jobs, 1063 specialists, 505 minds and 68 mini tools.
- Imported skills keep their open-licence sources and credits (MIT, Apache 2.0, BSD, CC BY, CC BY-SA). Local changes are identified on the page and in the skill file.
- Minds are AIs built from a person's public work, with their sources listed. They are not the person. Minds that invest teach frameworks only, never buy or sell advice.
- Skills that scrape websites or need a paid outside account say so on their page.
- Last changed 2026-10-29. See the [JSON Feed](https://useaiblocks.com/feed.json) or [RSS](https://useaiblocks.com/feed.xml) for what changed.

## Planning and privacy

- Use search to find relevant skills. A skill page shows what to prepare before it and what can use its result next. Add the steps you need to the builder.
- When planning with your AI, keep the original request and use relevant supplied context, including me.md when available. Read the chosen methods and supporting files. Give each step a clear task, required material, expected result and checks.
- Public API and MCP workflow tools return plans and instructions. They do not run skills or make model calls on your behalf. Your AI runs the work with its own tools and credits. The signed-in website planner uses the AI Blocks service.
- Saved personal and company workflows require their connected account and access checks. Never put credentials or private workflow links in public searches. A prepared plan is not approval to send, spend or publish.

## How to use a skill

- Every skill has a page and a skill file. For example: [Ad angle planner](https://useaiblocks.com/skills/ad-angle-planner), and its file [SKILL.md](https://useaiblocks.com/skills/ad-angle-planner/SKILL.md). Add the file to your AI as a skill, or paste it into a chat.
- [Every page by job](https://useaiblocks.com/jobs), and the whole catalogue as data: [blocks.json](https://useaiblocks.com/data/blocks.json)

## Main pages

- [Plan an AI team](https://useaiblocks.com/teams): review outcome-first specialist plans, input/output handoffs and permissions. Use scope_specialist_request, prepare_scoped_specialist_work and prepare_recommendation_handoff to turn evidence-backed chosen recommendations into work for the next orchestrator. Work and artifacts remain in the user's AI and authorized local project by default. MCP prepare_specialist_team and checkpoint_specialist_team validate current sources and host-reported checkpoints; authenticated personal/company connections support explicit workflow saves, scoped memory and reviewed revocable sharing. No public hosted execution.
- [Workflow planner](https://useaiblocks.com/compose): describe a task, review a plan and download it for your AI
- [Hire an AI specialist](https://useaiblocks.com/roles): choose a job role, its deliverables and methods, then prepare a complete role pack. MCP tools find_specialist and prepare_specialist choose and onboard a worker for a task. Read aiblocks://roles/{id} for SOUL.md, knowledge, playbook, method routing, connection requirements, editable training/context and permission boundaries. API: GET /api/v1/specialists?task=... and POST /api/v1/specialist-preparations. Execution happens in the user’s AI.
- [Your me.md](https://useaiblocks.com/me-md): prepare reusable context for your AI
- [API and MCP](https://useaiblocks.com/api-and-mcp): connect an AI and read the public API documentation
- [All skills by job](https://useaiblocks.com/jobs): every skill, workflow and prompt, sorted by the job it does
- [How it works](https://useaiblocks.com/how-it-works): from one prompt to your own AI app
- [Minds](https://useaiblocks.com/minds): hire a great thinker's method for your problem
- [From a source](https://useaiblocks.com/from-a-source): turn a video, article or course into skills
- [Mini tools](https://useaiblocks.com/tools): calculators for prices, margins, discounts and AI costs
- [Apps](https://useaiblocks.com/apps): an example AI app and a starter pack
